androidRouting.defaultOverload: ConnectionsManager.sendRequest(TLObject,RequestDelegate) delegates at offset2 to its QuickAckDelegate/int overload. Both the QuickAckDelegate/int and flags-only overloads load connectionType1 into v8 at offset0 and pass it to the full sendRequest at offset12. Type1 clears bit64 in the pinned sendRequestInternal and enters HelperHttp.
androidRouting.terminationScanScope: Linear scan for new-instance of leaveGroupCall/discardGroupCall and equivalent Group/Conference class names. All five matching methods in the three DEX files that referenced those types use type64 for the matching termination request. Zero instruction decode failures in those files. No proof about reflective or native callers.

webRouting.transport: The pinned Web worker's chooseServer at byte24029 returns transportHTTP. The observed group methods are actual invokeApi call sites in that worker, not only schema entries.

inputGroupCall.source: getGroupCallInput at byte524916 returns the ID and access hash of an already known call.

joinGroupCall.limitation: The Android join serializer also includes its own optional public key/block fields. Do not substitute the Web join schema.

discardGroupCall.matchingAction: GroupCallsManager.hangUp with an explicit boolean true

leaveGroupCall.matchingAction: GroupCallsManager.hangUp with the numeric local source

webRouting.terminationLimit: This source supports a Web HTTPS construction candidate for matching termination. Neither acceptance nor authoritative end acknowledgement was observed. Calling hangUp without its exact argument can take the join fallback; do not use that fallback as cleanup.
webRouting.streamChannelsLimit: Web _fetchRtmpState invokes getGroupCallStreamChannels at byte527127, but this pinned worker has no corresponding method declaration. Do not infer a usable Web RPC from the call site alone.

offlineReadOnlyFixture.scope: Synthetic call ID/access hash and zero limit. Existing generic TL codec compared against the pinned serializer in a test-only schema. Production CallClient remains unable to invoke this method.

supergroupOrChannel.input: inputChannel(-212145112) with selected channel ID and access hash

existingGroupLookupFixture.source: Both AppProfileManager processResult functions read full_chat.call and save it to the group call cache. getGroupCallInput then derives the matching InputGroupCall from that cached record. The operator can select an existing group locally without sending a call ID or access hash through chat.
existingGroupLookupFixture.fixtureValidation: Pinned Web serializer and existing generic codec match for both requests and complete synthetic metadata replies with/without the optional call reference. Missing reference stops before any group-read fixture. Mismatched or truncated metadata fails closed. Output reports only two booleans, without group, call or participant identifiers or names.
existingGroupLookupFixture.scope: Test-only, bounded selected group metadata. No production RPC enablement, provider read, session access or group creation.

privateStatusRunner.endpointBinding: The endpoint is pinned to the previously used default Web account endpoint, and the runner refuses a future default change. No server override, redirect, automatic endpoint selection or plaintext route.
privateStatusRunner.scope: Explicit self-confirmed Web session and one locally selected consented group. The selector takes kind chat or channel and its local entity ID, with the channel's local access hash only when applicable. The call reference comes from the matching metadata reply in memory.
privateStatusRunner.bounds: One metadata request plus at most one matching group read with limit0. A shared deadline up to15 seconds, existing 64KiB response limit, strict TL bounds and exact account/group/call checks. A missing reference completes without the second request.
privateStatusRunner.privacy: No ID, access hash, token, profile, chat, participant, title, or raw provider error is returned or logged. available means matching group status was decoded, not that a call or media path worked.
privateStatusRunner.validation: Injected synthetic fetch only. No CLI, production route, vault access, real account, or live request in the dry run.

nextSafeProtocolAction: With a known consented existing test group call, compare a single read-only phone.getGroupCall on its previously verified Web HTTPS session endpoint. This cannot establish secure create/join/termination by itself. No new group call, join, or termination attempt is justified until exact cleanup acknowledgement is verified for that route.
